body: The International Astronomical Union (IAU) was founded on the 28th of July 1919. It is an international association of professional astronomers, at the PhD level and beyond, active in professional research and education in astronomy.The IAU includes a total of 12,664 individual members who are professional astronomers from 96 countries worldwide (as of 1 February 2017).
